verdict.rationale: A probe confirms GitLab publishes an llms.txt at docs.gitlab.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, titled 'GitLab Documentation'), so an agent can be pointed at it directly. GitLab also documents agent-oriented guidance: the Orbit skill gives AI coding agents structured instructions, and a raw OpenAPI 3.0 spec is available for machine consumption. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth and coverage (e.g., a full-text variant or per-page markdown), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.gitlab.com/llms.txt # GitLab Documentation
The GitLab Orbit skill gives AI coding agents structured guidance for querying the GitLab Orbit graph.
The GitLab Orbit skill teaches your agent to query your GitLab data, such as merge requests, pipelines, and vulnerabilities
